acts.desc: Sarah's mom, Mrs. Matthiessen, doubts that the staff of This American Life can find great stories about her conversational no-nos.
acts.label: Prologue
Act One
acts.desc:
Okay, so we admit, that this story that a woman named Ninon told Sarah at a dinner party isn’t
strictly about menstruation, but we're going to beg indulgence because it has all the key
ingredients of a good menstruation story.
acts.title: Period

acts.label: Act Two
acts.desc:
Dr. Steven Bratman has spent a lot of time around people with extreme and unusual diets. He tells Ira Glass that for some of them, it's not about losing weight but about becoming more pure.
Dr. Bratman is the author of Health Food Junkies.
acts.title: Diet

acts.label: Act Three
acts.desc:
Deborah Lott comes from a family that obsesses over health. And when they all get together for dinner, their banter goes on overdrive. She recorded their last dinner party, and assures producer Brian Reed that this is a typical dinner for them.
Deborah recently completed a memoir, Tell Me I’m Still Breathing: A Memoir of an Anxious Childhood. You can find more of her work at her website.
acts.title: Health

acts.label: Act Four
acts.desc:
Dr. Cady Coleman is a NASA astronaut who has spent more than 4300 hours in space. Our senior
producer Julie Snyder asked her what it's like to sleep while orbiting the earth.
acts.title: Sleep

acts.label: Act Five
acts.desc:
A group of people have a dream club that meets twice a month to talk about their dreams. Sarah
and her mom join one of their meetings.
acts.title: Dreams

acts.label: Act Six
acts.desc:
Chris Garcia and his dad were driving home, listening to oldies, sharing a bag of chips. A totally familiar scene for them. They’d driven this route probably hundreds of time, but something odd was happening in the car, so Chris started recording their conversation on his phone. He tells producer Nancy Updike what happened.
Chris is a comedian. We first heard him talking about his dad on Marc Maron's WTF podcast (Chris's part starts around at around 30:30). You can find more of his comedy at his website.
acts.title: Route Talk
